This '''[[Otoga-222 maintenance droid/Legends|Otoga-222 maintenance droid]]''' was built by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] out of scrap and old parts on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to assist [[Gender/Legends|him]] while working at [[Wald's Parts|Watto's Shop]]. He often rebuilt the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to accomplish specific tasks.<ref name="PotJ" />
